CustomField.description: BR-15, BR-16, PD-12. When Sales explicitly declined the MQL handoff. STOPS THE DECISION CLOCK: without a persisted rejection time an on-time rejection and a late one are indistinguishable, so the commitment could not be measured at all. A SEPARATE FIELD FROM Lifecycle_Stage_Entered__c for the same reason as Sales_Accepted_At__c - that one is overwritten on every later transition. Rejection is NOT disqualification and NOT Closed - Not Converted; the Lead remains MQL. Written only by Lead_Inbound_Before_Save at the moment a governed rejection is recorded.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When Sales declined this handoff. Set by automation - do not edit.
CustomField.label: Sales Rejected At
